title: AI-first team wiki SaaS (reordered pitch)
idea: The thesis first: Notion is passive storage, and what a team actually needs is active knowledge maintenance. So we sell to series-A startups that already pay for Notion + Slack, at $12/seat/month with a 10-seat minimum. Integrations are Slack, Google Meet, and Notion import. The mechanism behind 'docs that update themselves' is a weekly AI refresh job. Concretely, it is a B2B SaaS wiki that auto-summarizes Slack and meeting transcripts into living docs.
focus_notes: Churn if AI summaries are wrong or noisy
Seat-min friction vs Notion free habit
Whether 'auto-update' creates trust issues with wrong edits
